# pinka-platform command

`pinka-platform` checks a platform release against contract v2 before anything on the host changes; bootstrap runs it during a platform deployment, and platform developers run it on their releases (see [Platform manifest](../platform-manifest.md)).

```text
pinka-platform [-h] {validate} ...
```

Validate a platform release against contract v2: the manifest's schema, the reserved names and the host, the invariant checks and the release's files.

## pinka-platform validate

```text
pinka-platform validate [-h] [--contract CONTRACT] [--no-host-check]
                               [--built] [--json]
                               release
```

Validate a staged release directory and print every problem, or a summary.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `release` | — | — | release directory with platform-manifest.yaml at its root |
| `-h`, `--help` | — | — | show the help and exit |
| `--contract` | `CONTRACT` | `/home/user/pokus/infra/contract` | contract directory (default: contract/ of this infra checkout) |
| `--no-host-check` | — | — | skip the checks against the accounts, groups and commands of this host |
| `--built` | — | — | the build has run: commands below .venv/ must exist too |
| `--json` | — | — | print the result as JSON |

## Exit codes

| Code | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `valid` | the release passed every check |
| 2 | `usage` | wrong arguments |
| 65 | `refused` | the release breaks contract v2; every reason is printed |
